# dev-env-doctor

> Diagnose a development environment from a JSON config: required tools and version ranges, environment variables and files, with an injectable command runner and CI exit codes Go module `github.com/Trysac/u175-dev-env-doctor`, package `devenvdoctor`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
